title: Fix Capacity Admission Starvation and Reservation Overcommit
description: Fix host capacity admission at its cause: (1) starvation of large waiting requests (starving-first head-of-line ordering), (2) overcommit by full reservations of long-running grants that really hold a fraction (settled charge floor was rampIdleKeepMegabytes 3072 so no grant under 3072 MB was ever reduced), (3) session cap must be work-conserving (bind only while another session waits). Test-driven with python oracle; no row schema change so live grants and old processes stay valid.
summary: Reclosed: the two red tests are not from the admission change (verified with the ordering and cap changes switched off). Fixed at cause: exactGrantRequired test value map gained the new placeholders; end-to-end envelope test now derives the expected memory from the real host sizing instead of assuming a 32 GB host. All 29 related test files pass. Details in result.md.
